278599521.description:
Product Overview:
This lot contains a variety of rough and semi-polished rocks, minerals, and stones in assorted sizes, shapes, and colors. Included are a geode with visible crystal formations, various types of quartz, agate, jasper, and possible specimens of petrified wood and pyrite. Some stones are tumbled while others remain in their natural, unpolished state. The collection also includes a small shell and a specimen housed in a clear display case.

Specifications:
- Types: Geode, quartz, agate, jasper, possible petrified wood, pyrite, and other mineral specimens
- Conditions: Mixed natural and semi-polished surfaces
- Additional Items: Small shell, specimen in clear display case

278054812.description:
Natural Gemstone Collection Lot Rough Polished Minerals Turquoise Quartz Agate
Large assorted lot of natural mineral and gemstone specimens including rough and polished stones. Features a labeled display box titled 'Natural Gemstone Collection - Jewels in the Rough' containing turquoise, citrine, agate, tiger eye, amazonite, fluorite, peridot, rose quartz, jasper, amethyst, crystal quartz, garnet, sodalite, carnelian, obsidian, azurite, rhodonite, chrysocolla, moonstone, alabaster, and black onyx. Includes additional loose stones such as a large white quartz geode, obsidian, agate slices, green and purple tumbled stones, and various other mineral and rock samples. Stones vary in color, size, and shape, all in natural condition with some polished surfaces and others raw. Suitable for collectors, educational use, or crystal enthusiasts.

The specimen is medium-sized, approximately the size of a large grapefruit. It is in good natural condition with no visible repairs or artificial enhancements. Suitable for mineral collectors, home decor, or metaphysical uses.
